title: Fun trying out different products
text: I hear about so may different beauty and skincare products, and the Allure Beauty Box sounded like a great opportunity to try some of them! I received my box within a week that I signed up and started trying some of the products immediately! Although I do not use certain items in my personal routine, I put some aside as future gifts. However, I loved trying out the other items, such as the moisturizer, lip oil, and face mask. I am looking forward to my next box!
label: positive
